summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases plus a non-node test. Ran pytest on the new tests and test/test_path.py with the generator venv: 40 passed. Line lengths are within 88 columns. Mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the venv, so type-check and formatting rules were applied by reading the code only. One deviation: the type-ignore for the expected-exception case sits on the parser-call line inside the pytest.raises block, not on the with line, because the with line has no argument error to suppress. No commits were made; git status shows only the two new files.
